description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class AboutOrganization, which encapsulates information about an organization's name, version, and employee counts. It includes private properties with getter and setter methods, and is part of the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system's admin module.

classes.name: AboutOrganization
classes.description: A DTO class that holds organization information such as company name, version, and employee counts.

methods.name: getNumberOfActiveEmployee
methods.description: Returns the number of active employees.

methods.name: setNumberOfActiveEmployee
methods.description: Sets the number of active employees.

methods.name: getNumberOfPastEmployee
methods.description: Returns the number of past employees.

methods.name: setNumberOfPastEmployee
methods.description: Sets the number of past employees.
